style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, hard sun, high exposure
motion_rule: one clear action per window and only one of them moves at a time; he never holds a pose; the roll grows longer every window; camera move and new shot size every window, never on a schedule
character: a palm-sized tarsier, grey-brown fur, thin long fingers, ENORMOUS round amber eyes, a loose office tie, alarmed
second_characters: ONE fat toad banker in a striped tie, throat ballooning, unrolling the schedule at the lens, never still
props: ONE honey-oak desk; ONE long paper roll of a payment schedule, ruled in blank squares; ONE round red stamp in the toad's paw; his tie; furry mic bottom right
prop_continuity: the roll in frame all clip, longer every window; the red stamp mark on his forehead from 3.35 to the end
environment: a sunlit bank office, tall window, oak panelling

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: high squeaky male voice, alarmed, even 4.5 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: mo-EE gla-ZA, VEE-dyat, o-SO-ben-no, SRO-ki, ot-da-VAT stress last, KA-zhet-sya, u-ZHE, ZAV-tra
audio.pacing: 0.9-3.35 one breath; one pause, 3.35-3.75; 3.75-6.85 one breath; after 6.85 not a word, sfx go on
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes on every syllable, not a voice over
audio.sfx: paper unspooling, a stamp thump, a toad croak, desk rattle

timeline.a: the toad flicks the roll and it smacks the tarsier flat across the lens
he peels the paper off his face, the roll pouring past him
he rears up, eyes filling half his head, paper draped on his shoulders
his head snaps a half turn backwards, body stays forward
he pulls the roll through his fingers hand over hand, faster and faster
no words. The toad swings the stamp down and it lands red on his forehead
he walks the taut roll at the camera like a tightrope
he bites the paper, it will not tear, he hangs off it
he throws both hands up and the roll winds him into a paper mummy
he hops the length of the desk inside the paper cocoon
he bursts out of the cocoon straight into the lens
no words. The toad throws the roll out the window and it keeps running down the street
he chases the paper on all fours across the desk
he catches the end and it snaps him back like a spring
he rides the recoiling paper into the lens till his face fills it
he winks, the red stamp still on his forehead, the roll running past his eye

must_appear: the roll smacking him flat at 0.0, the stamp landing red on his forehead at 3.35, the paper mummy at 4.65, the roll running out the window at 6.85, the stamp still on his forehead in the wink at 9.55
negative_prompt: night, low key, a still camera, a human hand with a microphone, an interview stand, him sitting still while speaking, a second tarsier, more toads, people, two actions at once, slow motion, any word after 6.85, silence in the tail, accented Russian, he holds a pose, letters, numbers, cyrillic, subtitles, a glowing emblem, a logo, watermark, English speech, black bands
